summary: Arch Capital Group Ltd. filed an 8-K on April 19, 2026, announcing a $3.0 billion increase in its existing share repurchase authorization. After this increase and recent repurchases, approximately $3.1 billion remains available under the program. Repurchases may be conducted in open market or privately negotiated transactions, subject to market conditions and regulatory considerations. The program is a capital return to shareholders, not a tender offer or going-private transaction. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is mentioned. Watch for actual repurchase execution and potential impact on share count; no risk-arb angle as it is an open-market program.
